name: Monte Clérigo
note: Powerful open beach break with hidden rock sections, holds 3 m+. Few surfers even on good days. Strong rips, urchins; not for beginners alone.

name: Arrifana
note: The Algarve's most popular surf beach, crowded, many schools. Beach peaks for intermediates; the right point at the north end is for experienced surfers. Cliffs shelter it from the summer north wind.

name: Bordeira (Carrapateira)
note: Swell magnet, the summer go-to when everything else is too small; exposed to the north wind. South point works low to mid, A-frame sandbars to the north on mid-high. Rips, rocks.
cam_shows: Praia do Amado, the next bay 4 km south. No camera at Bordeira.

name: Amado
note: Reliable, multiple peaks, all levels, surf-school hub so crowded on weekends. Sand with some rock, rips. A little more shelter from the north wind than Bordeira.
cam_shows: Praia do Amado, Aljezur (not the Portimão beach of the same name)

name: Cordoama / Castelejo
note: Very consistent, inside and outer sandbars, all levels but rips and rocks. Castelejo is the next cove 1 km south, same setup. Cold water year round.

name: Beliche
type: beach break over rock and sand
note: Hollow and powerful even when small, breaks close to shore. Needs a big NW swell to wrap in, or a S swell. Experienced surfers, strong rips, territorial locals. Long staircase.
cam_shows: Sagres camera, beach not named on the page; about 5 km away. No camera at Beliche.

name: Tonel
note: Below the fortress, low-tide pitching hollow peaks, barrels when it lines up, holds 3 m+. Rocks show at low tide, rips. Picks up less swell than the west coast. Rarely crowded.
cam_shows: Sagres camera, beach not named on the page; about 2.5 km away.

name: Mareta
note: In-town south-facing beach, fast wedgy peaks. Needs a big W swell wrapping the cape or a S swell; the classic call when Tonel and the west coast are double overhead. Sheltered from the north wind. All levels, crowded.
cam_shows: Sagres camera, beach not named on the page; about 1.5 km away.

name: Zavial
note: Best south-coast point when a big W swell wraps or a S swell arrives; steep take-off, holds real size. Fickle, sectiony, heavy localism, rips, rocks. Experienced only.
cam_shows: Praia da Luz, 13 km east. No camera at Zavial.

name: Praia da Luz
note: Winter spot on north winds; hollow, fast, ledgy lefts and rights on a S swell. Inconsistent, sometimes crowded, localism, rips.

name: Praia da Rocha
note: Weak, fun, multiple peaks, all levels; the alternative when Sagres is too big. Windswell more than groundswell, unreliable, crowded in season. The north wind is offshore here.

name: Praia de Faro
note: Barrier-island beach, hollow fast short rides, the most consistent spot on the south coast. Works on SW groundswell wrapping the cape or on S windswell. Crowded weekends.
